stem: An application must keep running on-premises indefinitely while its data is served from a local cache backed by Amazon S3, rather than completing a one-time cutover.

choices.text: Run a one-time AWS DataSync transfer job
Set up AWS Transfer Family endpoints for the application
Deploy AWS Storage Gateway for hybrid storage access
Schedule a recurring AWS DataSync task to copy the data to S3

rationale: AWS Storage Gateway is built for exactly this pattern: keeping an on-premises application running indefinitely while it is served from a local cache backed by AWS storage, rather than a migration that finishes and disconnects. A one-time DataSync transfer job completes a migration and then stops running; it does not provide ongoing local-cache access afterward. Transfer Family provides managed file-protocol endpoints for external partners, not local application access to on-premises data. Even a recurring DataSync task only copies data between the share and S3 on a schedule; it does not serve the application from a local cache the way a gateway does.
